name: Interior AI
summary: Interior AI is a generative design tool for interior spaces. It allows users to upload photos of rooms and instantly visualize them in different styles, layouts, or with virtual renovations. It's widely used by homeowners, realtors, and designers for inspiration and planning.
description: Interior AI is a generative design tool for interior spaces. It allows users to upload photos of rooms and instantly visualize them in different styles, layouts, or with virtual renovations. It's widely used by homeowners, realtors, and designers for inspiration and planning. Style Selection: Preview rooms in dozens of design styles. Virtual Staging: Add or remove furniture and decor. Room Redesign: Experiment with layouts and color palettes. Photo Upload: Use any room photo for instant results.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Upload Room Photo
howToUse.description: Create an account on Interior AI and upload a photo of your room.

howToUse.title: Choose a Style
howToUse.description: Select from a variety of design styles and staging options.

howToUse.title: Preview & Edit
howToUse.description: View the AI-generated redesign; make adjustments to furniture and layout as needed.

howToUse.title: Download & Share
howToUse.description: Save your new room designs or share them with others.

features_fr: Sélection de styles : prévisualisez les pièces dans des dizaines de styles de conception.
Mise en scène virtuelle : ajoutez ou supprimez des meubles et de la décoration.
Refonte de la pièce : Expérimentez avec les dispositions et les palettes de couleurs.
Téléchargement de photos : utilisez n’importe quelle photo de pièce pour des résultats instantanés.
